limitations: These are actual assistive runtime checks driven and visually inspected by Codex, not a human listening session or exhaustive WCAG certification.
Speech synthesis used the actual espeak-ng engine with ALSA null output; emitted utterances and synthesis counts are retained, raw speech/debug/browser-session capture was removed.
Only the recorded Chrome/Orca/OS and Safe Metadata journeys were checked. Existing audit/browser and tenant-isolation proof remains in the managed receipts.
Folder availability degraded during some reads; delivered unavailable/Retry evidence was preserved and was not converted into Complete.
Adjacent Orca utterances can lag a keyboard event; emitted order is retained and input effects/focus are also checked independently.
